revisions.description:
Creates a copy of a file. Folders cannot be copied.

The file will be owned by the Service Account used. We recommend providing a shared parent folder or adding new permissions after the copy.

changelog.reason: Service Account Key takes the whole JSON key file; Client Email and Private Key stay for revisions that use them; the task no longer fails on an undeclared variable

params.label: Service Account Key
params.helpertext: The service account's whole JSON key file, pasted as-is. Replaces Client Email and Private Key
params.name: serviceAccountKey

params.label: Private Key
params.helpertext: The service account's private key. Not needed when Service Account Key is set
params.name: privateKey

params.label: Client Email
params.helpertext: The service account's client email. Not needed when Service Account Key is set
params.name: clientEmail

params.description: The IDs of the parent folders which contain the file. If not specified the file will be placed directly in the user's My Drive folder.
params.label: Parent Folders
params.helpertext: New line delimited list of folder IDs
params.name: parents

params.description: If not specified the file will end up being being prefixed with 'Copy of' and then the current name.
params.label: New Name
params.helpertext: The name to set on the copied file
params.name: fileName

results.description: The IDs of the parent folders which contain the file.
results.name: parents

results.description: The time at which the file was created
results.name: createdTime

results.name: modifiedTime
